title.zh: 将北三宝颜省辛丹甘市镇潘加拉兰村Pangalalan小学的名称变更为Juan Bugarin小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Pangalalan Elementary School in Barrio Pangalalan, Municipality of Sindangan, Province of Zamboanga del Norte, to Juan Bugarin Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Pangalalan Elementary School in Barrio Pangalalan, Municipality of Sindangan, Province of Zamboanga del Norte, to Juan Bugarin Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Pangalalan Elementary School in Barrio Pangalalan, Municipality of Sindangan, Province of Zamboanga del Norte, thành Trường tiểu học Juan Bugarin
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Pangalalan Elementary School in Barrio Pangalalan, Municipality of Sindangan, Province of Zamboanga del Norte, เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Juan Bugarin
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Pangalalan Elementary School in Barrio Pangalalan, Municipality of Sindangan, Province of Zamboanga del Norte, menjadi Sekolah Dasar Juan Bugarin
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Pangalalan Elementary School in Barrio Pangalalan, Municipality of Sindangan, Province of Zamboanga del Norte, menjadi Sekolah Rendah Juan Bugarin

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1964/ra_4011_1964.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Pangalalan Elementary School in Barrio Pangalalan, Municipality of Sindangan, Province of Zamboanga del Norte, is hereby changed to Juan Bugarin Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1964.
